title: Nebka (Necherophes)
summary: King of Egypt's Dynasty 3 at Memphis, called Necherophes by Manetho and Nebka in the Turin Canon.
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 3 at Memphis, called Necherophes by Manetho and Nebka in the Turin Canon. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "A. Djoser’s Famine culminated with the death of Uenephes: 2001–1994 BC"
reign.note: Start of the reign ("the start of his reign in 2029 BC"), which CFAH takes as the start of Dynasty 3.

reign.date: Start Sole-rex: 2030/2029; End Sole-rex: 2011/2010; Death or Deposition: 2001
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 7 "Integrated Dates for Dynasties 3 & 4", p. 94

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "A. Djoser’s Famine culminated with the death of Uenephes: 2001–1994 BC"
death.note: "the death of Nebka/Necherophes shortly before 2001 BC".
